title: Time to live
hints: time.Duration counts nanoseconds. Converting a number of seconds with time.Duration(n) gives n nanoseconds, not n seconds.
Turn the expiry into a time.Time with time.Unix(expiresAt, 0) and subtract: expiry.Sub(now). That also keeps the fractional second in now.
If the result is negative the token has already expired, so return 0.
